description: This file provides localization (internationalization) strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin for the Bosnian language ('bs'). It defines functions returning translated UI messages used in the plugin's interface.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the localized message for loading errors.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too long with number of characters to delete.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of selectable items.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message indicating no results found.
